definitions.explanation: One's overall physical well-being or state of health at a given time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{体調|たいちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: I'm not feeling very well today.

examples.japanese: {体調|たいちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}して→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I got sick and took the day off from work.

examples.japanese: {体調|たいちょう}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take care of your health.

notes:
{体調|たいちょう} refers to one's general physical condition, especially health status.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体調|たいちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|い}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ - to be in good/bad condition
- {体調|たいちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧ - to become unwell
- {体調|たいちょう}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ - health management
- {体調|たいちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧/⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to recover one's health
- {体調|たいちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧ - to take care of one's health
- {体調|たいちょう}⟦{不良|ふりょう}→不良：11320_furyou⟧ - poor health condition

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {体調|たいちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いかが→いかが：02846_ikaga⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ - How are you feeling?
- {体調|たいちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧ - Take care of yourself

{体調|たいちょう} VS ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧:
{体調|たいちょう} refers to one's current physical state (temporary), while ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ refers to health in a more general, ongoing sense.
